svg.text: इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया । विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु ॥
iti te jñānam ākhyātaṁ guhyād guhyataraṁ mayā / vimṛśyaitad aśeṣeṇa yathecchasi tathā kuru
The Lord has explained confidential knowledge; now deliberate fully and then act as you choose — responsibility remains
KUTUMBA teaching meaning — not labeled as BBT translation
